description: OPTIONI '3 ' - a digit typed with a trailing space - which is the case that proves the JUSTIFIED RIGHT receiver at app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl:45. Byte 2 is a space, so the descending scan at 117-121 stops at WS-IDX 1 and line 122 sends only the leading byte '3'. Because WS-OPTION-X is declared PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT, that one byte lands at the RIGHTMOST position and the receiver is space-filled on the LEFT, giving ' 3' and not '3 '; line 123's INSPECT then makes it '03'. A left-justifying implementation would produce '30', which is out of range and would be rejected - so the transfer to COUSR02C, the third option, is the observable difference between the two. The map agrees with the receiver: app/bms/COADM01.bms:145-149 declares OPTION with JUSTIFY=(RIGHT,ZERO).
